welcome._help: First message when the chat opens, plus the buttons under it. quick_replies are topic ids from the topics list below. topics.title: Do you set up the domain and hosting?
topics.answer: We set up your domain and hosting for you and deploy the site, so you never have to touch a server. Once it's live we also set up SEO and analytics.

topics.title: How does your process work?
topics.answer:
It's four steps:
1. Say hi: message us or fill the short form. We call you within a day.
2. See it first: you get a design to approve before any code is written.
3. Watch it build: a live preview link updates as we go, and you can comment on anything.
4. Go live: we set up the domain and hosting and launch.

topics.title: How do I pay?
topics.answer: We agree the price and payment schedule with you before we start, so there are no surprises. Message us and we'll share the details.

topics.title: Who are you?
topics.answer: I'm {bot_name}, a simple assistant that answers common questions about our websites. For anything I can't answer, a real person is on WhatsApp.

topics.title: Can I talk to a person?
topics.answer: Of course. Please contact our team on WhatsApp or book a project and we'll call you within a day.

topics.title: Do I need to write my own website content?
topics.answer: No. Send us what you have, even voice notes or your Instagram captions, and we'll shape it into copy that sells.

topics.title: Can I edit my website later?
topics.answer: Yes. We can set up an editor so you can change text, images and products without us. We're also here for changes after launch.

topics.title: What if I don't like the design?
topics.answer: You approve the design before we build anything, and revisions are part of the process.

topics.title: Can I see my website before I commit?
topics.answer: Yes! You can see a free preview of your site before you commit. Use the 'See your website first' page, or book a project and we'll show you a design to approve.

topics.title: Can I see your past work?
topics.answer: You can browse our concept websites on the Work page. They show the kind of site we build, and client projects are added as they go live.

topics.title: Can you build an online store?
topics.answer: Yes. Our online stores are mobile-first with a product catalogue, and we can set up WhatsApp order alerts so you stop taking orders in DMs.

topics.title: Will my website show up on Google?
topics.answer: Every site is built Google-ready, and we set up SEO and analytics as part of going live.

topics.title: Why choose you over a template builder?
topics.answer: Every site is designed around your business and hand-coded by engineers, using AI to move faster but never to cut corners. No templates, and a real team on WhatsApp when you need us.

topics.title: How do I start a project?
topics.answer: Great! Fill the short form and we'll call you within a day, or message us on WhatsApp.

topics.title: Will my website work on mobile?
topics.answer: Yes. Every site is built mobile-first and checked on phones, tablets and desktops.

topics.title: Is my website secure?
topics.answer: Yes. Every site is served over HTTPS (SSL is included) and we follow standard security practice for forms and logins.

topics.title: Who owns the website?
topics.answer: You do. Once the project is paid in full, the domain and the finished website belong to you, and we hand over access. Details are in our Terms.

topics.title: How many pages can my website have?
topics.answer: Business websites are typically 5 to 15 pages. Need more? Tell us and we'll quote it.

topics.title: Can my website be in another language?
topics.answer: Yes, we can build multilingual sites. Tell us which languages you need and we'll include it in the plan.

topics.title: Can you connect my website to other tools?
topics.answer: Yes. We can add a WhatsApp chat or order button, an Instagram feed, Google Maps, analytics and payment links. Tell us what you use and we'll connect it.

topics.title: Do I pay for domain and hosting every year?
topics.answer: Domain and hosting have yearly charges paid to the provider. We tell you the exact numbers upfront, so there are no surprises later.

topics.title: How quickly do you reply?
keywords: how long do you take to reply
topics.answer: We call you within a day of your request. WhatsApp messages are usually answered the same day, {hours}.

topics.title: Can you build custom features or apps?
topics.answer: Yes. Beyond standard sites we build custom features like booking, logins and dashboards. We focus on websites and web apps; for a mobile app, message us and we'll tell you what's possible.

topics.title: Who will build my website?
topics.answer: A small team of engineers designs and codes every site in-house, and you talk to the same people throughout.

topics.title: Do you work with clients outside India?
topics.answer: Yes. We work with clients anywhere, and everything runs online over WhatsApp, calls and email.

topics.title: Is my information private?
topics.answer: Yes. What you share with us stays private, and we're happy to sign an NDA if you need one.

topics.title: What if I want to cancel the project?
topics.answer: You can stop at any point and you only pay for the work already done. Message us and we'll talk it through.

topics.title: Can I get email addresses on my own domain?
topics.answer: Yes. We can set up professional email addresses on your domain, like hello@yourbusiness.com.

topics.title: Will you show me how to use my website?
topics.answer: Yes. We walk you through the site and share a short guide, so you can manage it with confidence.

topics.title: Do you have client reviews?
topics.answer: Our Work page shows concept websites we built to show our style, and we add client projects and testimonials as they go live. You can also see a free preview of your own site before you commit.
